//: Copy this to signing.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values.
//endpoint: Must match the region your Artifact Signing account was created in. A mismatch gives HTTP 403 and a SignerSign() failure, not a helpful error.
//accountName: The Artifact Signing account name, not the resource id.
//certificateProfileName: Use a Public Trust profile for anything you ship. A 'Public Trust Test' profile carries the lifetime EKU 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.10.3.13, which makes the signature expire with the 3-day certificate even when timestamped.
//subscriptionId: Optional. Only used to check you are signed in to the right place before signing.
